title: Kauai Waimea Canyon, Wailua River Boat and Fern Grotto Tour

merged.title: Kauai Waimea Canyon, Wailua River Boat and Fern Grotto Tour
merged.overview: Experience the natural wonders of Kauai on this full-day guided tour, featuring a scenic Wailua River cruise to the lush Fern Grotto and breathtaking views of Waimea Canyon from Pu‘uhinahina Lookout. Visit iconic spots like Opaekaa Falls, Spouting Horn, and the Kauai Coffee Estate, where you can sample locally grown coffee. With a knowledgeable guide, air-conditioned transport, and plenty of photo stops, this tour offers a perfect blend of relaxation, history, and stunning landscapes. Wailua River cruise, Fern Grotto, and Spouting Horn blowhole Learn the history and geography of Hawaii Expert commentary from your professional driver/guide Pick-up and drop-off from selected Kauai hotels

merged.title: Kauai Waterfall Picnic Tour and Off-Road Adventure
merged.overview: Star in your own Kauai action adventure with this off-road waterfall tour at Kipu Ranch. Rumble through the filming locations of classics like ‘Jurassic Park’ and ‘Raiders of the Lost Ark’ on rugged 4x4 trails, and hike to the banks of the Huleia River for a refreshing swim. Splash into waterfall pools via a giant rope swing, and replenish your energy with a waterside sandwich buffet.
itineraryStops: Kipu Ranch Off Road Vehicle and waterfall tour
